name: Mason Gooding
bio: Mason Gooding (born November 14, 1996) is an American actor. The son of actor Cuba Gooding Jr., he has appeared in television series and films. He had a recurring role in the television series Ballers (2018) and a starring role in the teen drama series Love, Victor (2020–2022).
